features.evidence: vocabulary 기여도 설명이 항목에 기록되어 있다

evidence_sources.text:
E2.2's directed_repair_pc fixture
(dir1_directed) failed 0/10 because the prompt/schema never exposed
structural_composition (or the other FeatureType vocabulary) as an available
repair value.

Root-cause analysis of E2.2.1's trial reports found the real
gap was two unstated structural contracts, not vocabulary

evidence_notes.ev5: E2.2.1's design commit message. Attributes the directed-PC fixture's 0/10 failure to the prompt/schema not exposing structural_composition or the rest of the FeatureType vocabulary as an available repair value.
evidence_notes.ev6: E2.2.2's design commit message. States that root-cause analysis of E2.2.1's trial reports found the real gap was two unstated structural contracts, not vocabulary, addressing the same referent as ev5 and reaching the opposite attribution. PROVENANCE CORRECTION (2026-07-28): an earlier version of this note said 'one commit later than ev5'. That is wrong -- git log 4017aff..559f61f shows three commits, with ce3699a ('record 20-trial results -- NO_GO, rate=0.15') and d706152 in between. ce3699a matters: ev5's attribution had already been measured as failing before ev6 was written, which bears directly on whether the two are of equal strength.
